<a name="DecodeStrict"></a>
## func [DecodeStrict](<https://github.com/brii26/release-signer/blob/main/pkg/b64/b64.go#L23>)

```go
func DecodeStrict(s string) ([]byte, error)
```

DecodeStrict decodes canonical RFC 4648 standard Base64. It rejects any byte outside A\-Z a\-z 0\-9 \+ / =, white space, wrong padding, and non\-zero trailing bits \(it re\-encodes the result and compares with the input\).

StdEncoding diam\-diam membuang \\r dan \\n, jadi alfabet dicek manual dulu.

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>

Input that is not canonical Base64 is rejected, including embedded newlines.

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/brii26/release-signer/pkg/b64"
)

func main() {
	ok, _ := b64.DecodeStrict("Zm9v")
	fmt.Println(string(ok))
	_, err := b64.DecodeStrict("Zm9v\n")
	fmt.Println(err != nil)
}
```

#### Output

```
foo
true
```

</p>
</details>
